If the subject brief does not call for Dreamy, do not add a character.

Lighting soft from upper left, darker navy undersides, subtle contact shadows only between objects. Not clay/plastic toy lumps, not flat vector, not pixel art, not painterly. Three-quarter frontal view for objects, original frontal floating cloud. Gold/cyan semantic arrows must have the same tactile material as the objects.
No generic stock clipart, irrelevant props, photoreal people, blurry text, excessive sparkles or tiny decorative clutter. Preserve the reference's visual identity while making the specified meaning clear.
